name: Halftone line
blurb: Black line, halftone dots, open contours
mechanism: Black line and black dots on warm paper, nothing else: every grey is a field of jittered halftone dots whose size tracks the tone, and the line around it is left open.

palette.name: Paper
palette.role: full-bleed card rect, hiding fills, highlight strokes inside black shapes

palette.name: Ink
palette.role: every line, every halftone dot, solid black masses (hair, leaves, bags, garments)

line: Black #111 line 2.0 at 480 wide (secondary 1.6-1.7, creases 1.3-1.6, tiny marks 1.1-1.3), round caps and joins, outlines left open with 1-3 gaps, one wobble filter (displacement 2.3 + 0.8) on the art group; tones are stipple dots at pitch 2.58, tone 0.19 or 0.36-0.38.
rules: Two inks only: black #111 on warm paper #f4f1ea
Every grey is jittered halftone dots, never a grey fill
Leave outlines open: gaps at corners, lines stop short
Dot tones 0.19 and 0.36; darker than 0.4 becomes solid black
Rubbery long-limbed profiles with dot eyes and nose wedges
Floor is short strokes plus dotted pools, never a full line
